description: This is a test source file for the UserRoleManagerHelper class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing authorization helper functionalities related to user roles and permissions.

classes.name: UserRoleManagerHelperTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the UserRoleManagerHelper functions in various scenarios such as permission checks and self-identification.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsForEmployeeWithoutAssignedEmployee
methods.description: Tests permission retrieval for an employee without an assigned employee record.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsForEmployeeWithAssignedEmployee
methods.description: Tests permission retrieval for a user with an assigned employee record.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsForEmployeeForSelfPermission
methods.description: Tests permission retrieval when the requested employee is the same as the user's own employee record.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsForEmployeeForNotSelfPermission
methods.description: Tests permission retrieval when the requested employee differs from the user's own employee record.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionCollectionForEmployee
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a data group permission collection and its conversion to array.

methods.name: getIsSelfByEmpNumber
methods.description: Data provider method supplying test cases for isSelfByEmpNumber method, testing if the user correctly identifies themselves based on employee number.
